title: Add auth-probe mode to existing release workflow for branch-only validation

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Switching to branch-only test path by adding workflow_dispatch probe mode to existing release.yml so it can be triggered without default-branch workflow file changes.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Implemented branch-only probe path by adding workflow_dispatch input auth_probe_only to existing .github/workflows/release.yml and an auth-probe job that runs git push --dry-run origin HEAD:main with anthusbot credentials. Removed separate release-auth-probe.yml to avoid default-branch workflow dispatch limitation.
